headline: Offset speaks on why he stayed cool with Gunna after the YSL Trial even after everyone cut
body: Offset speaks on why he stayed cool with Gunna after the YSL Trial even after everyone cut him off: I’m not a follower. I rock with who rock with me... All that bull[sh*t] divided our city and then made each artist pay for it... At the end of the day, we ran the whole hip-hop scene. Now it’s a gap. ” (via Popcast). Allegations are not findings of guilt.
